topography.project_purpose: Snowbank is a reserve currency protocol on Avalanche that issues the SB token, which is backed by a basket of assets. It provides staking and auto-compounding mechanisms to incentivize long-term holding and grow the treasury.
topography.relationship_narrative: The TimeERC20Token serves as the core SB token, while TimeStaking handles staking rewards and AutoFarmV2_CrossChain provides auto-compounding functionality, likely interacting with the staking contract to reinvest rewards.
